Each time domain is required to have exactly one global time master, but may have multiple ports acting as time (sub-) master (see Time Gateway) to relay global time from the global time master to the time slaves. The global time master may or may not exist on the configured ECU. The exact role of the port is derived implicitly. EthTSynGlobalTime Slave | 0..1 Configuration of a time slave. Each global time domain is required to have at least one time slave.
